name: Gia Coffeehouse

location.address: Sardar Jangal St (north of Sattari Highway, after Abshenasan), Zeytoon St, Norouzpour St, Neshat Alley 1, Tehran

media.alt: Real photo from Gia Coffeehouse's Instagram

description: One of Punak's most loved coffeehouses, known for a modern, cozy interior with ample parking. Hosts occasional art exhibitions, live music nights, and poetry readings, making it as much a cultural hub as a coffee stop.
